route_meta.visa_type: Danish Residence and Work Permit for Students (ST1 Scheme / Higher Education Route)
route_meta.official_channel: Danish Agency for International Recruitment and Integration (SIRI) & Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark

processing_meta.validity: Granted for Full Duration of Accredited Degree Programme + 6 Months Post-Study Job Seeking
processing_meta.length_of_stay: Full Study Programme Duration (Continuous Legal Residence)
processing_meta.entry: Multiple Entry (Biometric Residence Card / Schengen Free Movement)

how_to_apply_steps: 1️⃣ Secure unconditional admission at an accredited Danish higher education institution.
2️⃣ Danish educational institution completes Part 1 of the online ST1 application form on nyidanmark.dk and sends the reference ID / password to the student.
3️⃣ Create a Case Order ID on nyidanmark.dk and pay the official SIRI processing fee (2,115 – 2,600 DKK) online.
4️⃣ Complete Part 2 of the ST1 application form on nyidanmark.dk, uploading passport, admission letter, and living funds proof.
5️⃣ Register and pay the Danish Embassy application fee (1,710 DKK) on the official ApplyVisa portal (applyvisa.um.dk).
6️⃣ Book an appointment and record biometrics at VFS Global Denmark within 14 calendar days of online ST1 submission.
7️⃣ Track application status on SIRI. Upon approval, receive entry visa sticker or travel to Denmark to collect your physical Biometric Residence Card (Opholdskort).

documents_checklist.title: Valid Passport
documents_checklist.description: Original passport valid for at least 3 months beyond the intended study permit duration with minimum 2 blank pages, issued within last 10 years.

documents_checklist.title: Official Unconditional Admission Letter
documents_checklist.description: Letter of acceptance from an accredited Danish higher education institution (University, University College, or Business Academy) confirming admission, start date, and course duration.

documents_checklist.title: Online ST1 Application Confirmation & Reference Code
documents_checklist.description: Online ST1 application form on newtodenmark.dk / nyidanmark.dk. (Part 1 completed and submitted online by the educational institution; Part 2 completed online by the student).

documents_checklist.title: SIRI Case Order ID Payment Receipt
documents_checklist.description: Official payment receipt for the SIRI fee (approx. 2,115 – 2,600 DKK) generated and paid prior to application submission.

documents_checklist.title: ApplyVisa (MFA Denmark) Fee Payment Receipt
documents_checklist.description: Official payment receipt from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Denmark portal (applyvisa.um.dk) for consular handling fee (1,710 DKK / approx. 230 EUR).

documents_checklist.title: Proof of Paid Tuition Fee or Scholarship Waiver
documents_checklist.description: Official bank transfer receipt proving full payment of first-year / first-semester tuition fees, or an official Danish government scholarship award letter.

documents_checklist.title: Recognized English Language Proficiency Certificate
documents_checklist.description: Official scorecard (IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 / TOEFL iBT minimum 88) as required by Danish university programme regulations.

documents_checklist.title: MEA Apostilled Academic Certificates & Transcripts
documents_checklist.description: Original Bachelor degree / Higher Secondary certificates and transcripts with MEA Apostille certification.

financial_proofs.type: Proof of Sufficient Living Expenses (Maintenance Funds)
financial_proofs.minimum_balance_or_amount: 6,500 – 6,800 DKK per month (approx. 78,000 – 81,600 DKK / approx. 9.5L–10L INR for one academic year)
financial_proofs.time_frame: Last 3 to 6 months bank statements in student's own name
financial_proofs.notes: Bank statements must be held in the student's sole bank account in a recognized bank, showing liquid funds readily available. Education loan sanction letters or official scholarship award letters are also accepted.

consular_directives.statutory_rule: SIRI ST1 Student Residence Scheme & 14-Day Mandatory VFS Biometrics Deadline
consular_directives.financial_benchmark: 6,500 – 6,800 DKK / month maintenance requirement if tuition is not state-funded

other_requirements.category: Biometrics Submission at VFS Denmark (14-Day Deadline)
other_requirements.details: Students MUST record biometrics (fingerprints and facial photo) at an authorized VFS Global Denmark center within strictly 14 calendar days of submitting the online ST1 application.
International students in higher education programmes are legally permitted to work up to 20 hours per week during the academic semester and full-time (37 hours/week) during June, July, and August.

other_requirements.category: Danish CPR Registration & Yellow Health Card
other_requirements.details: Upon arrival in Denmark, register your address at the local International Citizen Service (ICS) / Citizen Service (Borgerservice) to obtain your Danish CPR number and free national healthcare coverage (Sundhedskort).
